# Security policy

Please do not disclose vulnerabilities, credentials, API keys, private URLs, or personal data in public GitHub issues, pull requests, discussions, or commits.

Until a private reporting channel is configured, report vulnerabilities to **security-contact@example.com** with a concise description, affected version or commit, reproduction steps, and impact. Replace this placeholder address with a monitored private security contact before publishing the repository.

Do not send live provider keys. Reports should use sanitized logs and deterministic sample data whenever possible. The maintainers will acknowledge reports privately and coordinate remediation before public disclosure.
